notes.title: Elder Sign: Omens compatibility update!
notes.content:
We have updated Elder Sign: Omens to support 64-bit iOS devices in anticipation of iOS 11! Our Steam build has been optimized to reflect changes made to the mobile versions.

Thank you for your support and feedback!

notes.title: Elder Sign: Omens - 1.4.2
notes.content:
New patch deployed fixing some minor bugs. 

• Fixed startup code to prevent unnecessary resolution switching. Should hopefully improve compatibility for users having problems starting up the app. 
• Fixed issue with scoreboard not remembering name properly.
